title.narrative: Support to the National Coordinator's Office in the programming of Pre-accession Assistance Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: To enhance the capacities of the National IPA Coordinator's (NIPAC) Office and, through NIPAC, the capacities of Sector Coordinating Institutions (SCI) and all relevant institutions at different levels of governance, as members of IPA structures, as well as the capacities of other stakeholders in Bosnia and Herzegovina, in effective utilisation of IPA funding, with a focus on the application of a sector approach, the NIC framework, and the preparation for the new Instrument for Pre-accession Assistance 2021-2027.
